What this means for your business

The Wi-Fi symbol only proves a device sees the shop’s wireless network. It does not prove the Wi-Fi box reaches the internet or that the register can reach its service.

What to watch

  • Every device fails at once versus only one device.
  • A wired computer works while Wi-Fi fails.
  • Failures cluster in one room or at one busy time.
  • The register shows a message from the company that runs it or says a security setting blocked it.

Do this next

  1. Record the time, devices, location, and exact error.
  2. Check the internet company that runs the tool and critical service status.
  3. Test one wired device and one nearby wireless device.
  4. Reboot only the identified layer, then document what changed.

When Little Fight fits

NYC businesses can call us for remote diagnosis or an approved on-site visit. Outside NYC, we can help with the website and documentation, not promise a local dispatch.
